forms.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.
The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.
Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.
The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.
Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.
With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.
Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.
Having been swallowed whole by Shellder, Slowbro now has an iron defense. It's pretty comfortable in there, too.
The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it. It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps a patient watch for its chance to attack.
The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.
It zips around at blistering speeds, looking for an opening to skewer its opponent on its giant pincers.
It zooms out of the water at Mach speeds. Even large ships caught in its path are split cleanly in two!
When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.
Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!
Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.
Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.
It's better at beating things than grasping them. When it battles for a long time, the weight of its pincers becomes too much to bear.
A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.
Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.
Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.
Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can't change direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack from behind.
Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.
Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.
The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.
Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.
When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.
It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.
It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.
Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.
It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.
Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.
It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.
It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.
It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.
It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.
The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it's not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.
Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.
Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.
This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.
With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.
It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.
It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.
Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.
Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.
Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.
By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.
This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.
It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.
Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.
Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.
If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.
Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.
Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.
It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.
One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.
The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.
It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.
It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.
This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.
This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.
The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.
Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.
It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others - and to control them.
It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.
It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.
Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.
In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.
It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.
It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.
Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.
This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.
A mechanism to remove Magerna's limitations has lain secretly with Magerna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.
It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.
Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.
Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its "necktie" around to wallop its foes.
Glimmora's petals-now larger and separated from its main body-rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.
Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.
It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.
Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.
Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.
